confirmed.statement: S1 and S2: The PDF explicitly states: "In both experiments, each participant was randomly and blindly assigned to one of three model conditions:"; the unit of assignment was the individual.

confirmed.statement: S1: Complete randomization jointly assigned the model configuration and one of 15 target images, producing 45 target-item/model cells.

confirmed.statement: S2: Complete randomization jointly assigned the model configuration and one of 15 logo briefs, producing 45 target-item/model cells; participants created original logos with open-ended creative possibilities.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 11, section 3.3; p. 34, Appendix B.1; p. 41, Appendix B.5.2.

confirmed.statement: S1 and S2: Assignment determined access to a text-to-image generative AI tool for participants' own work. Participants submitted prompts, viewed the generated images, and iterated using their assigned model.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 34, Appendix B.1; p. 39, Appendix B.4.1; p. 41, Appendix B.5.1; p. 44, Appendix C.3, item 1.

confirmed.statement: S1 and S2: The DALL-E 2 arm used the earlier image generator without intermediate prompt rewriting, matching the form.

S1 and S2: DALL-E 3 (Revised) retained default hidden GPT-4 rewriting; DALL-E 3 (Verbatim) used the same image generator with a hidden prefix requesting no rewriting. The reported 59% residual modification rate supports the form's caveat that rewriting was reduced, not eliminated.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 9, section 3.1; p. 38, Appendix B.2, treatment definitions and final paragraph.

confirmed.statement: S1 and S2: All three participant arms provided generative AI. Comparisons are between AI configurations, matching the form's arms and ai_design contrasts.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 9, section 3.1; p. 38, Appendix B.2.

confirmed.statement: S1 and S2: Each participant repeatedly prompted one assigned model configuration, supporting the between-person coding. Repeated attempts were not a crossover between conditions, so randomized condition order is not applicable.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 9, section 3.1; p. 39, Appendix B.4.1; p. 41, Appendix B.5.1.

confirmed.statement: S1 and S2: The interface displayed earlier prompts and images, but model requests had no conversational memory; participants were informed of this and were unaware of hidden prompt rewriting.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 9, section 3.1, paragraphs on rewriting, model memory, and the interface; p. 38, Appendix B.2.

confirmed.statement: S1 and S2: Cross-model replay was a later researcher procedure using submitted prompts, not additional participant assignment. S2 image-presentation randomization applied to the LLM judge and was separate from random assignment of participants to assistance.

summary: The PDF explicitly supports individual random assignment in both experiments to the three coded generative-AI configurations for participants' own image generation. The arms and between-person design match the form, and criterion 1 holds through the open-ended logo experiment.
